name: Gaming & Community

designIntent.primaryGoal: Help members find people, events, updates and shared activities quickly.
designIntent.visualThesis: Expressive community identity balanced with clear moderation, status and navigation.

visualDirection.density: medium-to-high in activity feeds and member lists
visualDirection.surfaces: separate social content, controls and moderation actions without excessive nesting
visualDirection.colorIntent: brand accent plus accessible status tokens; never rely on color alone for presence or rank
visualDirection.typography: distinct display voice with readable small-screen body and metadata
visualDirection.motion: feedback for reactions, live events and state transitions; no flashing or unavoidable loops

layout.pattern: community navigation + feed/events + member or detail sidebar
layout.spacing: compact lists with clear grouping and strong control hit areas
layout.responsive: prioritize feed and current event; secondary panels move into navigation

accessibility.keyboard: all community navigation and moderation actions must be reachable
accessibility.focus: modals and menus manage focus correctly
accessibility.reducedMotion: disable flashing, pulsing and non-essential animated backgrounds

antiPatterns: rank or role communicated only by color
notes: Make reporting, blocking and moderation paths discoverable and understandable.

aiGuidance.primaryFlow: Discover a community or event → understand activity and rules → participate → manage identity and safety.
prioritize: The current event, discussion or activity that matters to the member
Identity, roles and presence with redundant labels
Reporting, blocking, moderation and safety affordances
confirmOrMarkUnknown: Community rules, age requirements and moderation model
Whether presence, membership and event status are live
Permissions for invites, posting and moderation
avoidByDefault: Glow as the only presence signal
Fake member counts, activity or tournament results
acceptanceChecks: Report, block and moderation actions are discoverable
Status uses text or icons as well as color
Keyboard navigation works across feeds and dialogs

compositionEscapes.when: A tournament, game night, launch or community event drives the current visit.
compositionEscapes.composition: Lead with event state, schedule and participation action; include teams, rules and supporting details only when confirmed.
contentRequirements: Real event name, schedule and timezone
Accurate eligibility, rules and join state
avoid: Fake live badges or participant counts

compositionEscapes.when: The main task is following ongoing discussion, updates or member contributions.
compositionEscapes.composition: Make the activity stream primary, with clear author/time context and contextual moderation actions; keep discovery and member lists secondary.
contentRequirements: Actual posts or labelled sample data

compositionEscapes.when: Users need to find a server, guild, group, channel or shared activity area.
compositionEscapes.composition: Organize discovery around topic, game, language or activity; show rules, membership requirements and recent activity before joining.
